key.name: pin-key
key.description: Toggles pin on the focused window: it cannot be moved or resized until unpinned.

key.name: titlebar-override-active
key.summary: Whether pinky is currently overriding the titlebar double-click action
key.description: Persisted so the extension can self-heal if the shell crashes while a window is pinned; without this the global action-double-click-titlebar would be left stuck at 'none' after a crash.

key.name: orig-titlebar-action
key.description: The value of org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences::action-double-click-titlebar captured before pinky set it to 'none'.
